capabilities: add reusable exclusion rules to graph view filters
hide notes by path, tag, or file name queries
toggle each exclusion rule on or off
share rules between the global graph and all local graphs
extras: Hooks into Obsidian's internal graph renderer because there is no public graph API, so a future Obsidian update may break it; the README asks users to open an issue if exclusions stop working.
intentEvidence: adds an Exclusions section inside the Filters panel of both the global graph and the local graph
problem: The built-in graph filters require retyping a search query each time you want to hide folders, tags, or files, and rules can't be switched off individually.
summary: Graph view extension that adds a toggleable Exclusions section to hide notes by path, tag, or file name in global and local graphs.
